page.title: OurTaikoNet · Charts and players, in one place
page.description: OurTaikoNet brings fanmade charts, the official song list and player pages together at net.ourtaiko.org: upload and try charts, see scores and titles, all with one OurTaiko account.
hero.tagline: Charts and players, in one place.
hero.description: Fanmade charts, the official song list and player pages, together on one website. With one OurTaiko account, upload, try, collect and keep every score.
features.title: It starts with a chart.
features.sub: Create, share, practise and meet others, all in the browser.
feature.uploadText: Upload TJA charts with their audio, one song or a whole folder at a time. Charts are checked by the same rules the game uses.
feature.previewText: Open a chart’s page to preview it, listen to the song, or play it right on the page.
feature.collectionsText: Gather favourite charts into playlists, or put together the community’s own dan courses.
feature.socialText: Leave comments, check the leaderboards, collaborate with charters and get notified of replies.
feature.profileText: Scores from both libraries, titles, dan badges and your nameplate, on one page.
feature.accountText: Sign in to the whole site with your OurTaiko account — the same one the game uses.
areas.title: Three areas. One website.
areas.sub: What used to be Fanmade, Database and Profile now all lives at net.ourtaiko.org.
areas.fanmadeText: Charts made by the community: search, try, comment and add them to playlists.
areas.officialText: Official songs and their charts, searchable by category and difficulty.
areas.playersText: Every player’s scores, titles and dan ranks, plus the latest activity on the site.
game.title: Connected to OurTaikoPlay.
game.sub: The charts and scores on the website are the ones in the game.
game.libraryText: The game reads both libraries, downloads songs and syncs your scores back to your player page.
game.roomsText: OurTaikoNet hosts the game’s online rooms, where up to five players play the same song.
game.signinText: Start signing in from the game, check the code in your browser and confirm, then carry on in the game.
moved.title: Old addresses still find their way.
moved.text: Pages at fanmade.ourtaiko.org, database.ourtaiko.org and profile.ourtaiko.org redirect to net.ourtaiko.org, and released versions of the game keep connecting as before.
